First, I need to understand what "fair share" means here. Fair share would typically mean each person pays an equal amount based on their contribution or the total cost divided by the number of people. If James paid three times that, he's contributing more than others. 

Now, why would he do that? Maybe he wanted to be generous, or perhaps he felt it was his responsibility. Alternatively, maybe he was trying to be pretentious, as mentioned in the [SEP] tag.
